name: populations
description: Multi-agent populations (W045): the typed record of MANY agents bound into one world. foundPopulation composes proven W044 bindings (each member re-proven through world-agent-runtime's own validators, errors carried verbatim; scope + declared-slot agreement with the world; duplicate member ids refused) into a content-addressed pop-<digest> Population record — membership in canonical binding-id order, the aggregate view AS CARRIED DATA (per-capability coverage over the members' own routing contracts, per-position fill over the W039 seats, the membership census — never re-scored), explicit scope, immutable generational lineage. Transitions (addMembers / retireMembers / ablateMembers citing the W039 ablation axis vocabulary) seal a NEW generation every time: the parent re-validated first (lineage breaks refused), the W040 registry re-proven through its own validator, dead endowment capabilities at transition time refused loudly with the W040 lifecycle carried verbatim, retirements cited by id with reasons as data. A14: a population COMPOSES records — it never executes, never steps a world, never trains (W046 owns curriculum/self-play, W048 owns episode generation). A9: same members + same world ⇒ deep-equal population, same canonical id; no clocks, no randomness, no env reads.
